raw_text: I am an enthusiastic Data Science graduate looking to secure an entry-level position where I can apply my academic knowledge of machine learning. My experience includes a comprehensive six-month internship at an e-commerce startup within a tight-knit data team of three people. During this internship, my primary responsibility was maintaining data pipelines built with pandas 2.0 and NumPy 1.24 to preprocess daily transactional logs. I successfully implemented an automated anomaly detection script using scikit-learn 1.2 that cut down data cleaning time from 45 minutes to just 12 minutes daily. Additionally, I assisted in deploying a lightweight Flask API for a product recommendation proof-of-concept that handled roughly 5,000 requests per day during peak testing hours. I also worked closely with senior software engineers to refactor data serialization logic, reducing API payload sizes by 18% across three testing environments. My academic foundation includes a Bachelor of Science in Data Science and Analytics, which I completed in 2025. For my capstone project, titled GreenRouting, I engineered a routing optimization algorithm using Python 3.11 and networkx to reduce delivery vehicle fuel consumption, resulting in a theoretical 14% reduction in carbon emissions across simulated urban areas. On my own time, I developed a personal project called StockSentiment, which utilized a fine-tuned DistilBERT model via PyTorch 2.1 to analyze financial news headlines and predict stock movements with a 72% classification accuracy. My current focus centers on mastering advanced deep learning workflows and containerized deployments using Docker, and my immediate career direction is to transition into a full-time Junior Machine Learning Engineer role where I can build production-ready predictive models that solve real-world problems.
summary: Junior Data Scientist with a Bachelor's in Data Science and internship experience optimizing data pipelines using pandas and scikit-learn.

raw_text: As a Mid-Level Machine Learning Engineer with four years of professional experience, I specialize in designing, training, and deploying robust predictive models that drive tangible business value. At my previous role within a mid-sized fintech startup, I spent two and a half years working in an agile data science squad of six engineers. My day-to-day responsibilities involved building credit risk classification models using scikit-learn 1.3 and XGBoost 1.7, where I successfully reduced model training latency by 35% through efficient feature engineering and parallel processing. I also spearheaded the migration of our batch processing workflows to an orchestrated pipeline using Apache Airflow, which reduced nightly data loading failures from 8% down to less than 0.5%. Prior to that, I spent one and a half years at a digital marketing agency where I developed customer segmentation algorithms using pandas 1.5 and scikit-learn's clustering modules, segmenting a database of over two million active consumer profiles to improve email campaign click-through rates by 18%. My academic background includes a Master of Science in Computer Science, graduated in 2022. Outside of my primary employment, I completed an internal engineering project called LogVision, designed to parse and classify server error logs in real-time using PyTorch 2.0 and a custom Bi-LSTM architecture, which ultimately decreased system troubleshooting time by 25 minutes per incident. My current focus is oriented towards mastering scalable model deployment patterns, specifically focusing on Kubernetes and Triton Inference Server, with the career objective of transitioning into a Senior Machine Learning Engineer or technical lead capacity within the next year.

raw_text: I am a Senior Data Scientist and Technical Lead with eight years of comprehensive experience architecting enterprise-grade machine learning solutions. In my current role at a large financial enterprise, I lead a cross-functional team of nine engineers and data scientists focused on fraud detection. Over my four-year tenure here, I architected a real-time fraud detection engine using PyTorch 2.2 and scikit-learn 1.4 that processes over 10 million transactions per day with an inference latency under 15 milliseconds, ultimately saving the organization an estimated 4.2 million dollars in annual fraudulent losses. I successfully moved our model deployment framework from legacy servers to a modern cloud architecture on AWS ECS, utilizing FastAPI 0.104 and PostgreSQL 15, which dropped our deployment cycle times from 120 minutes down to just 10 minutes through automated CI/CD pipelines. Previously, I spent four years at an enterprise software corporation as a Senior Data Scientist where I designed predictive maintenance models using pandas 1.4 and NumPy 1.22 for industrial IoT clients, improving asset uptime by 22% across 50 manufacturing plants worldwide. I also optimized database query processing times by 40% through extensive restructuring of PostgreSQL indexing schemas. I hold a PhD in Statistics, completed in 2018. As a passion project, I developed an open-source library named GraphRec, which applies graph neural networks via PyTorch Geometric to optimize e-commerce recommendation systems, achieving a 12% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank over baseline models on standard datasets. My current focus is dedicated to the ethical governance of AI and the implementation of robust MLOps observability frameworks, aiming to advance into a Principal AI Architect role.
summary: Senior Data Scientist and Technical Lead with 8 years of enterprise experience architecting real-time fraud detection systems using PyTorch and AWS.
